title: 美国人向露丝·巴德·金斯伯格致敬
desc: 美国人向露丝·巴德·金斯伯格致敬

paragraphs.en: Candles, flowers, and handcrafted signs surround the United States Supreme Court in memory of justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg who died Friday. It just kind of crushed me.
paragraphs.zh: 蜡烛、鲜花和手工制作的标语环绕在美国最高法院周围，以纪念周五去世的大法官露丝·巴德·金斯伯格。这真的让我心碎。

paragraphs.en: While Ginsburg's health had been deteriorating for the past several years, her death stunned many Americans including president Donald Trump.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管金斯伯格的健康状况在过去几年里一直在恶化，但她的去世还是令包括总统唐纳德·特朗普在内的许多美国人感到震惊。

paragraphs.en: She led an amazing life. What else can you say? She was an amazing woman.
paragraphs.zh: 她度过了非凡的一生。你还能说什么呢？她是一位了不起的女性。

paragraphs.en: Whether you agreed or not, she was an amazing woman who led an amazing life. I'm actually saddened to hear that. I am saddened to hear that.
paragraphs.zh: 无论你是否认同，她都是一位拥有非凡人生的非凡女性。听到这个消息我真的很难过。

paragraphs.en: Democratic presidential nominee Joe Biden said she was not only a giant in the legal profession but a beloved figure.
paragraphs.zh: 民主党总统候选人乔·拜登表示，她不仅是法律界的巨擘，还是一位深受爱戴的人物。

paragraphs.en: She practiced the highest American ideals as a Justice: equality and justice under the law, and Ruth Bader Ginsburg stood for all of us.
paragraphs.zh: 作为大法官，她践行了美国最崇高的理想：法律面前人人平等与正义；露丝·巴德·金斯伯格代表着我们所有人。

paragraphs.en: I don't know a woman who's not going to be affected by this, I don't know a single one.
paragraphs.zh: 我认识的所有女性都受到了她的影响。

paragraphs.en: Ginsburg's advocacy for women's rights propelled her beyond legal stardom and into American pop culture.
paragraphs.zh: 金斯伯格对女性权利的倡导使她不仅成为法律界的明星，还融入了美国流行文化。

paragraphs.en: People started calling her the Notorious RBG, a reference to the famed rap artist Notorious B.I.G.
paragraphs.zh: 人们开始称她为“声名狼藉的RBG”，这是对著名说唱歌手声名狼藉先生的致敬。

paragraphs.en: Her status as a cultural icon grew when it was discovered the octogenarian worked out at the gym religiously, something that continued through the coronavirus pandemic.
paragraphs.zh: 当人们发现这位八旬老人一直坚持去健身房锻炼，甚至在新冠疫情期间也未曾中断时，她作为文化偶像的地位便愈发稳固。

paragraphs.en: Tributes to Ginsburg plastered the Brooklyn New York neighborhood in which she grew up.
paragraphs.zh: 向金斯伯格致敬的标语贴满了她成长的纽约布鲁克林社区。

paragraphs.en: William Brenneisen owns Ginsburg's childhood home.
paragraphs.zh: 威廉·布伦内森拥有金斯伯格童年时期的故居。

paragraphs.en: We've been here 47 years and we still hear her name during the course of all year, so she's not really forgotten.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在这里已经47年了，一整年里我们仍会时不时听到她的名字，所以她并没有真正被遗忘。

paragraphs.en: It was not lost on American Jews that Ginsburg died on the eve of Rosh Hashanah, the Jewish New Year.
paragraphs.zh: 美国犹太人都注意到，金斯伯格是在犹太新年前夕去世的。

paragraphs.en: But it was her fierce defense of women's rights that defines how she is being remembered.
paragraphs.zh: 但正是她对女性权利的坚定捍卫，定义了人们如何铭记她。

paragraphs.en: Well, she stood up for women. She was not swayed, easily swayed.
paragraphs.zh: 她为女性发声。她不会轻易动摇。

paragraphs.en: And she just had people's best interests at heart, viewed the world differently to a lot of men. I have great respect for her.
paragraphs.zh: 她只是把人们的最大利益放在心上，看待世界的方式与许多男性不同。我非常尊敬她。

paragraphs.en: Ginsburg will be buried at Arlington National Cemetery, next to her husband Martin who died in 2010.
paragraphs.zh: 金斯伯格将被安葬在阿灵顿国家公墓，与她2010年去世的丈夫马丁葬在一起。
